decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core competence, so its accumulated knowledge lets it keep interpreting results and refining the line.
The flagship designer drain builds directly on the firm's proven drainage technology and design focus, making it central to the firm's strategic direction.
The sloped shower element complements the firm's floor-level and waterproofing systems, although it lies further from its metal fabrication base.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies established drainage and sealing know-how to a related segment where the firm can assimilate market feedback.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with weaker knowledge links, but it rounds out the system offer at low cost.
